title: WEB-6: Inventory every QNFO setup step (Search Console, analytics, DNS, email, status, social) and clone the list here
body:
**Owner:** Ops
**Trigger:** CONN-1
**Done check:** Checklist with one row per QNFO service and its Ultrastable twin
**Status:** closed

Source of truth: `docs/roadmap.md` (item WEB-6). Every closed item proposes a plus: file it as a new issue labeled `plus`.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 273.0 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
